name: Cargo Global Eats (Scarefest)
note: Cargo's Scarefest village outside the World of David Walliams, listed in the park app as "CARGO GLOBAL EATS Street food" (cargo-global-eats-street-food). Dates are Scarefest's own (open on selected days: 26-27 Sep, 2-4, 9-11 Oct, 16 Oct to 1 Nov); no source gives separate dates for the food village. Seen on 27 Sep 2026.
